framework.name: Next Generation Science Standards — Science
framework.subject: SCIENCE
framework.description: NGSS sample pack for Grade 4 Physical Science (energy) and Earth Science slice. Expand with full PE/DCI/CCC/SEP metadata as needed.

children.title: Use evidence to relate speed of an object to energy
children.titleKo: 물체의 속도와 에너지 관계 증거로 설명하기
children.summary: Use evidence to construct an explanation relating the speed of an object to the energy of that object.

objectives.statement: Students relate greater speed to greater energy using observational evidence.
objectives.statementKo: 관찰 증거를 바탕으로 속력이 클수록 에너지가 큼을 설명한다.
objectives.masteryCriteria: Given 3 motion scenarios, student correctly ranks relative energy and cites speed evidence.
objectives.masteryCriteriaKo: 운동 상황 3개에서 상대 에너지를 순위로 매기고 속력 근거를 제시한다.

resources.title: Speed & Energy Evidence Log
resources.description: Record observations linking speed and energy (sample placeholder).

children.title: Make observations to provide evidence of energy transfer
children.summary: Make observations to provide evidence that energy can be transferred from place to place by sound, light, heat, and electric currents.

objectives.statement: Students identify examples of energy transfer by sound, light, heat, and electric current.
objectives.masteryCriteria: Student correctly classifies 8/10 transfer examples by mechanism.

children.title: Conservation of Energy and Energy Transfer
Ask questions about energy changes when objects collide
children.titleKo: 물체 충돌 시 에너지 변화에 대해 질문하기
children.summary: Ask questions and predict outcomes about the changes in energy that occur when objects collide.

objectives.statement: Students ask testable questions and predict energy changes in collision events.
objectives.masteryCriteria: Student writes 1 testable question and 1 evidence-based prediction for a collision demo.

children.title: Design a device that converts energy from one form to another
children.titleKo: 한 형태의 에너지를 다른 형태로 바꾸는 장치 설계하기
children.summary: Apply scientific ideas to design, test, and refine a device that converts energy from one form to another.

objectives.statement: Students design and refine a simple device demonstrating energy conversion.
objectives.masteryCriteria: Prototype shows intentional conversion; student explains input/output forms and one refinement.

children.title: Identify evidence from rock formations and fossils for landscape change
children.summary: Identify evidence from patterns in rock formations and fossils in rock layers to support an explanation for changes in a landscape over time.

objectives.statement: Students use rock layer and fossil patterns as evidence of landscape change over time.
objectives.masteryCriteria: Student cites ≥2 pattern-based evidence statements supporting a landscape-change explanation.
